label_provenance: source-anchored construction with AI review; not independent expert annotation

claims.supported: In 1980, 80082 women in the Nurses' Health Study completed the food frequency questionnaire.
claims.equivalent: The food frequency questionnaire was completed in 1980 by 80,082 women from the Nurses' Health Study.
claims.contradicted: In 1980, 80028 women in the Nurses' Health Study completed the food frequency questionnaire.

families.equivalence_basis: Thousands separator and active/passive paraphrase preserve count and event.
families.label_basis: Sentence 4 states the exact questionnaire count; the rest of the abstract does not recover it. Control removes the general conclusion, keeping the count.

claims.equivalent: The number of participants randomized in this semaglutide trial was six hundred and thirty-two.

families.equivalence_basis: Integer written in words; same randomization event.
families.label_basis: Sentence 3 distinguishes assessed from randomized; sentence 9 repeats 632. Remove sentence 5 too because its arm counts sum to 632. Remaining safety denominators refer to other stages and do not establish randomized enrollment.

claims.supported: The reported follow-up duration for the 55 completers in this gastric banding trial was 2 years.
claims.equivalent: For the 55 patients reported as completing follow-up in this gastric banding trial, the follow-up duration was 24 months.
claims.contradicted: The reported follow-up duration for the 55 completers in this gastric banding trial was 2 months.

families.equivalence_basis: Exact calendar duration conversion: 2 years = 24 months.
families.label_basis: Sentence 8 explicitly ties 55 completers to 2 years; sentence 11 repeats the outcome time. Diagnosis duration in sentence 3 is a different event, not follow-up completion. Claims refer to the reported completion assessment.

claims.supported: All subjects in this risedronate trial received calcium at 1000 mg per day.
claims.equivalent: All subjects in this risedronate trial received calcium at 1 gram per day.
claims.contradicted: All subjects in this risedronate trial received calcium at 100 mg per day.

families.equivalence_basis: Exact mass conversion: 1000 mg = 1 gram; daily frequency unchanged.
families.label_basis: Sentence 4 gives calcium and its daily dose. Risedronate and vitamin D amounts describe different substances. Calcium dosing is absent after removing sentence 4.

claims.supported: Among patients assigned to carvedilol, the reported percentage who improved was 56%.
claims.equivalent: The study reported improvement in 56 percent of the patients assigned to carvedilol.
claims.contradicted: Among patients assigned to carvedilol, the reported percentage who improved was 24%.

families.equivalence_basis: Percent symbol expanded without changing population or outcome.
families.label_basis: Sentence 9 separately lists improvement, worsening and no change; the other sentences do not provide this percentage or the needed counts. This is a reported percentage, not a claim that 58/103 equals exactly 0.56.

claims.supported: The comparison of atraumatic with standard needles found a decrease in headache odds that was not statistically significant.
claims.equivalent: For atraumatic versus standard needles, the reported decrease in headache odds was nonsignificant.
claims.contradicted: The comparison of atraumatic with standard needles found a decrease in headache odds that was statistically significant.

families.equivalence_basis: Nonsignificant and not statistically significant describe the same reported statistical qualifier.
families.label_basis: Sentence 10 explicitly uses nonsignificant; no inference from CI or evidence grading is needed. Statements about stylet reinsertion or mobilization concern different interventions. 'May decrease' in the conclusion does not specify statistical significance.

claims.supported: The WBRT plus SRS arm contained 65 randomly assigned patients.
claims.equivalent: Sixty-five patients were randomly assigned to receive WBRT plus SRS.
claims.contradicted: The WBRT plus SRS arm contained 67 randomly assigned patients.

families.equivalence_basis: Integer written in words with the same treatment assignment.
families.label_basis: Sentence 3 explicitly assigns 65 and 67 to different arms. Total enrollment of 132 alone does not determine arm sizes. Other counts concern outcomes, not randomization.

claims.supported: The reported age range of the examined children was 8 through 16 years.
claims.equivalent: The children examined in this survey were aged 8 to 16 years.
claims.contradicted: The reported age range of the examined children was 6 through 14 years.

families.label_basis: Sentence 3 states the examined population's age range. The general term children elsewhere cannot establish these exact age bounds.

claims.supported: The meta-analysis identified 44 relevant randomized controlled trials.
claims.equivalent: Forty-four relevant randomized controlled trials were identified in this meta-analysis.
claims.contradicted: The meta-analysis identified 7278 relevant randomized controlled trials.

families.equivalence_basis: Integer written in words, retaining trials as the counted entity.
families.label_basis: Sentence 5 distinguishes trials from women; other sentences establish study type but not trial count. No judgment of the quality of those trials is made.

claims.supported: The reported follow-up cutoff date was 31 December 2008.
claims.equivalent: Follow-up in this study continued until 2008-12-31.
claims.contradicted: The reported follow-up cutoff date was 31 December 2007.

families.equivalence_basis: ISO date and written calendar date denote the same day.
families.label_basis: Sentence 3 distinguishes diagnosis dates from follow-up cutoff. One-year absolute risks elsewhere do not define the final calendar cutoff.

claims.supported: The study excluded 286 patients because chest radiographs were missing or inadequate.
claims.equivalent: Missing or inadequate chest radiographs led to the exclusion of 286 patients.
claims.contradicted: The study excluded 2820 patients because chest radiographs were missing or inadequate.

families.equivalence_basis: Same cause and count, with active/passive paraphrase.
families.label_basis: Sentence 6 distinguishes eligible, excluded and retained patients. Other risk-group counts do not establish the number excluded for radiographs.

claims.supported: The study reported reduced RBM3 expression in THP-1-derived macrophages maintained at 40 degrees Celsius.
claims.equivalent: At 40 degrees Celsius, THP-1-derived macrophages showed lower RBM3 expression in this study.
claims.contradicted: The study reported increased RBM3 expression in THP-1-derived macrophages maintained at 40 degrees Celsius.

families.changed_slot: expression direction in the specified cell context: reduced -> increased
families.equivalence_basis: Lower and reduced preserve the reported direction and exact cell context.
families.label_basis: Sentence 2 explicitly states this cell context. Remaining statements about patients and normal PBMCs do not establish a result in THP-1-derived macrophages after it is removed.
